verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents several APIs (Raw Event Export, Query API, Feature Flags API), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent AI-access features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
